newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma cut to hold.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Dana Voelzke has cut Brazilian brewer Companhia Cervejaria Brahma SA's rating to hold from buy.

-- "Volume growth in the Brazilian beer sector is slowing as domestic real incomes remain flat, and market share could be sensitive in the short term to the consolidation of the company's distribution system," Voelzke wrote in an April 22 report.
-- The fiscal 1997 price target for Brahma shares was set at $725 per 1,000 shares, "less than 10 percent upside from current levels," he said.
-- Brahma shares were unchanged at 740 reais in Sao Paulo.
